I recently visited Tooth Therapy Dental Clinic in Bangkok for a dental cleaning, and I must say, my experience was nothing short of amazing. Coming from a very traumatizing dental experience in New Zealand, I’ve always had severe anxiety about visiting the dentist. However, Dr. Mana and her incredible team changed that for me.

From the moment I walked in, I was greeted with warmth and genuine care. The entire team went above and beyond to ensure I felt comfortable and at ease. Dr. Mana's professionalism, coupled with her compassionate approach, made a world of difference. She took the time to explain each step of the process, addressing all my concerns with patience and understanding.

The level of comfort and love I received from everyone at the clinic was truly exceptional. They created a calm and reassuring environment, making my dental visit a positive experience for the first time in years. I cannot thank Dr. Mana and her team enough for their outstanding service and dedication to patient care.

If you’re looking for a dental clinic that prioritizes your comfort and provides top-notch professional care, I highly recommend Tooth Therapy Dental Clinic. They have genuinely transformed my outlook on dental visits, and I am incredibly grateful for their exceptional service.

Got my Invisalign here, and all my dental care.
They do their job professionally, not on a cheap side of course but so far the most professional dental place I’ve been to in the country. Great booking system and their front desk team is great. *note I don’t live in Bangkok, but my appointments and booking has been amazing.

Absolutely fantastic. First saw them in 2007 for major bridge and crown works which would have taken about 10 sessions and cost $50,000 in Sydney.in Bangkok, all prep work was done in one day on the way to a business trip in Europe and completion in half a day on my return at a total cost of just over $11,000!
11 years later all Bridges and crowns are still intact and I never had any issue. My Aussie dentist stated that the work done in Thailand was a lot better than what he has seen in Australian.
Highly recommended! A great professional team. Thank you DC One!
